The Hidden Room
A suspense story for English learners 🔎
🏠🔑👣
🎯 Get ready

Lesson Objectives

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

  • 1 Read and understand a short suspense story.
  • 2 Learn new vocabulary from context.
  • 3 Answer reading comprehension questions.
  • 4 Discuss the story using simple English.
  • 5 Describe pictures using complete sentences.

📖 Part 1

Emma's Quiet Life

Emma lived alone in an apartment in the city. It was quiet, close to her office, and the perfect size for just one person.

Every evening was almost the same. She ate dinner, washed her dishes, and watched TV. She went to bed early and slept with the light off.

One morning, Emma noticed something strange. Her cup was on the table, but she was sure she had left it by the sink the night before.

She did not worry about it for long because she needed to go to work.

🖼️ Picture 2

Look Carefully

📖 Part 2

Something Is Wrong

That night, Emma woke up for no clear reason. The room felt different. The air felt heavy. She listened. Everything was quiet.

She turned on the light. The room looked normal.

Days passed. Small things changed. A chair was not in the right place. A door was not fully closed. Emma noticed, but she said nothing.

📖 Part 2

Something Is Wrong

Then food started to disappear. She bought bread — the next day, there was less. She bought cheese — part of it was gone.

Emma lived alone. She locked the door every night. She checked it twice before bed.

Emma began to feel nervous. She woke up more often at night and listened to every sound.

📖 Part 2

Something Is Wrong

One night, Emma woke up and did not move.

She heard breathing.

It was close.

Emma stayed very quiet and listened. After a long time, the breathing stopped.

She turned on the light. No one was there.

✅ Reading Check

Answer the Questions

Tap a question to check your answer.

Why did Emma wake up? ▸
AnswerShe woke up for no clear reason — the room felt different and the air felt heavy.
What small things started to change? ▸
AnswerA chair was not in the right place, and a door was not fully closed.
What food disappeared? ▸
AnswerBread and cheese disappeared.
How many times did Emma check the door? ▸
AnswerShe checked it twice before bed.
What did she hear one night? ▸
AnswerShe heard breathing, very close to her.
What happened when she turned on the light? ▸
AnswerNo one was there.

📖 Part 3

Calling for Help

The next morning, Emma called the police. They came and looked around the apartment.

"We don't see a problem," one officer said. Emma wanted to believe him, but she did not feel calm.

After that, things got worse. She came home one evening and smelt soap — not the soap she used, and the smell was very strong.

She left at once and slept at her sister's house.

🖼️ Picture 4

Look Carefully

📖 Part 4

The Hidden Room

The next day, she came back with the police. This time, they looked more carefully.

One officer touched the wall near the hallway. It made a strange sound.

He pushed. Part of the wall moved.

📖 Part 4

The Hidden Room

Behind it was a small room — just long enough for a person to lie down in. There was a blanket. Empty food boxes. A cup.

Emma felt sick. "Someone has been living here," the officer said.

The police ran outside. They checked the building. They checked the street. No one was found.

📖 Part 4

The Hidden Room

Later, the police told Emma they had seen many cases like this in the area. Each time, the person left before the police arrived.

Emma moved away soon after. She does not live alone now. She keeps the lights on at night. She listens carefully.

Because she knows quiet does not always mean empty.

✅ Reading Check

Answer the Questions

Tap a question to check your answer.

What did the police find behind the wall? ▸
AnswerThey found a small hidden room.
What was inside the hidden room? ▸
AnswerA blanket, empty food boxes, and a cup.
Did the police find the person? ▸
AnswerNo, no one was found.
Why did Emma move away? ▸
AnswerBecause someone had secretly been living inside her home, and she no longer felt safe there.
What lesson did Emma learn from this experience? ▸
AnswerQuiet does not always mean empty — she learned to stay alert, even when everything seems calm.
